survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD TALIS 2024 note reports results based on the TALIS 2024 database, using internationally comparable survey data collected from lower secondary teachers and principals in 2024. The note does not provide the underlying microdata weighting variables or replicate-weight procedures, but TALIS results are produced to reflect the complex survey design (sampling of schools and teachers) and to support population-representative estimates within participating countries. Because this document is a descriptive results note (not an ML modeling paper), it does not specify whether analysts should apply student/teacher sampling weights (e.g., TOTWGT/W_FSTUWT-style variables) or replicate weights (e.g., BRR/jackknife) when reproducing the tables. For interpretation, the key methodological caution is that the note only comments on statistically significant differences/changes and that some estimates may be affected by non-response bias, as indicated in the figures.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: Plausible values are not applicable because this TALIS note is based on self-reported questionnaire items and descriptive indicators (percentages of teachers/principals selecting response categories), not cognitive achievement scores that are typically scaled via PVs. Missing-data handling is not reported because the note is a country results summary that points to OECD TALIS 2024 database tables rather than detailing imputation/deletion procedures for item non-response. This is therefore a reporting/format limitation of the note rather than evidence that no missingness exists.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: The note presents TALIS 2024 findings for North Macedonia based on responses collected in 2024 from lower secondary teachers and principals. It does not specify additional analytic filters (e.g., grade subsamples beyond lower secondary, exclusions for item non-response, or specific table-level restrictions), so the analytic sample is assumed to be the full available TALIS 2024 lower-secondary teacher/principal sample used to produce the referenced OECD database tables.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD TALIS 2024: North Macedonia note summarizes descriptive results from the OECD Teaching and Learning International Survey, which collects self-reports from lower secondary teachers and principals. The document reports country percentages and compares them to an OECD average, highlighting only statistically significant differences or changes. It covers teachers’ background (age, gender, non-teaching work experience), teaching for today’s world (adaptation to cultural diversity, special education needs context), social and emotional skills, technology use (including AI use in the prior 12 months), teachers’ learning opportunities (initial teacher education, induction/mentoring, professional learning), teacher leadership/autonomy, professional relationships, status of the profession, employment terms, demands of teaching (stress sources and working time), and professional outcomes (lesson aim fulfilment, well-being, satisfaction, retention intentions). The note cautions that TALIS relies on perceptions and that some estimates may be affected by non-response bias, and it does not provide microdata-level modeling details or ML-based predictive performance.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This is a descriptive OECD results note rather than an empirical ML/predictive study. It does not report an analytic sample size, PV-based achievement outcomes, missing-data handling procedures, or any ML algorithms/metrics; instead it references OECD TALIS 2024 database tables and reports percentages and statistically significant differences. Consequently, fields related to ML techniques and structured predictive findings are intentionally left empty.
